entities.summary: Leah Marie Liang Lewis is a Chinese-born American actress. She is best known for her roles as Georgia "George" Fan in The CW series adaptation of Nancy Drew (2019–2023) and Ellie Chu in the Netflix comedy-drama film The Half of It (2020). She also starred in a lead voice role as Ember Lumen in the Pixar animated film Elemental (2023), and portrays attorney Sarah Franklin in the legal drama series Matlock (2024–present).
